assets.prompt: A sheet of 96x96 frames of a floating living staff at 2x detail (two art pixels a world pixel, drawn at half size in the game) for a top-down 32x32-unit pixel game, the curl head redrawn from its 48x48 sheet: a Wood shaft bowing gently between the grip and the head, gold Spark grip wrap and band, a spiral a turn and three quarters round a bright round gem in the player colour with a Bone light glint; the curl stays on top of the shaft whichever way it points. The grip at (48, 54) of every frame. 16 columns, the staff pointing clockwise from right in 22.5 degree steps, each drawn, never rotated; 4 rows, the same staff with the gem in each player colour ramp (blue, rose, green, purple). Light from the top-left, a one-pixel dark outline. An indexed PNG of palette colours from docs/STYLE.md, every pixel fully clear or fully opaque.
